G5300.def:
ὗς, ὑός, ὁ, ἡ
[in LXX for חֲזִיר ;]
swine: fem. (sow), 2Pe 2:22,†
(AS)

G5301.def:
ὕσσωπος, -ου, ἡ
[in LXX for אֵזוֹב ;]
hyssop, of which a bunch was used in ritual sprinklings: Hb 9:19; of a branch or rod (?) of hyssop, Jo 19:29 (but see Field, Notes, 106 ff., for suggestion to substitute ὑσσῷ here).†
(AS)

G5302.def:
ὑστερέω, -ῶ
(ὕστερος), [in LXX for חָסֵר, חָדַל etc. ;]
to come late, be behind (opposite to προτερέω, φθάνω; with genitive of thing(s), for; with genitive of person(s), later than).
Metaphorical,
__1. of persons,
__(a) absol., to come short, fail: Hb 4:1; before ἀπό, Hb 12:15.;
__(b) with genitive of person(s), to come short of, be inferior to: 2Co 11:5; οὐδέν (in nothing, in no respect), 2Co 12:11;
__(with) with reference to things, to come short (of ), be in want (of ): with accusative of thing(s), Mt 19:20 (Sir.51:24); with genitive of thing(s), Lc 22:35; so mid. (Diod., FlJ), Rm 3:23; absol., to be in want, suffer want, Lc 15:14, 1Co 8:8, 2Co 11:8, Hb 11:37 (Sir.11:11); opposite to περισσεύειν, Fp 4:12; before ἐν, 1Co 1:7.
__2. Of things,
__(a) to fail, be lacking: Jo 2:3; with accusative of person(s) (see Swete, in l; Mozley, Sl 42:1-11), Mc 10:21;
__(b) to be inferior: mid., 1Co 12:24 (cf. ἀφ-υστερέω).†
(AS)

G5303.def:
ὑστέρημα, -τος, τό
(ὑστερέω), [in LXX: Jz 18:10 19:19-20, Sl 34:9 (מַחְסוֹר), Ec 1:15 (חֶסְרוֹן), Et 6:9 (ὑ. εἶναι, חֲשַׁח) * ;]
__(a) that which is lacking, deficiency, shortcoming: with genitive puss. (prop. pose.), 1Co 16:17, Fp 2:30; with genitive of thing(s), Cl 1:24, 1Ts 3:10;
__(b) need, want, poverty (Sl 34:10, Jz 18:10, al.): Lc 21:4, 2Co 9:12 11:9; opposite to περίσσευμα, 2Co 8:13-14 (eccl.).†
(AS)

G5304.def:
ὑστέρησις, -εως, ἡ
(ὑστερέω), [in Aq.: Jó 30:3 * ;]
need, want: opposite to τὸ περισσεῦον, Mc 12:44; καθ᾽ ὑ., Fp 4:11 (eccl.).†
(AS)

G5306.def:
ὕστερος, -α, -ον
[in LXX for אַחֲרוֹן and cogn. forms ;]
latter, later: ἐν ὑ. καιροῖς, 1Tm 4:1 (on the reading ὁ ὕ., WH, for ὁ πρῶτος, see WH, App., in l). Neut., τὸ ὕ., used adverbially instead of ὑστέρως, afterwards, later: Mt 4:2 21:29, 32 21:37 25:11 26:60, Mc 16:14, Lc 20:32, Jo 13:36, Hb 12:11; with genitive, Mt 22:27.†
(AS)

G5307.def:
ὑφαντός, -ή, -όν
(ὑφαίνω), [in LXX chiefly for חָשַׁב ;]
woven: Jo 19:23.†
ὑφαίνω,
[in LXX for אָרַג, etc. ;]
to weave: Lc 12:27, T, WH, mg.†
(AS)

G5308.def:
ὑψηλός, -ή, -όν
[in LXX chiefly for בָּמָה, also for בָּמָה, רוּם, etc. ;]
high, lofty: ὄρος, Mt 4:8 17:1, Mc 9:2, Ap 21:10; τεῖχος, Ap 21:12; μετὰ βραχίονος., figuratively, At 13:17 (cf. Êx 6:6, al); pl., ὑψηλά, of heaven (Sl 93:4, Is 33:5, al.), Hb 1:3; compar., ὑψηλότερος τ. οὐρανῶν, Hb 7:26. Metaph: Lc 16:15; ὑψηλὰ ψρσνεῖν, Rm 11:20 12:16, 1Tm 6:17 (WH, txt., ὑψηλοφρονείν).†
(AS)

G5309.def:
ὑψηλο- φρονέω, -ῶ
= μευαλοφρονεῖν (Xen., Plat., al.),
to be high-minded: 1Tm 6:17 (WH, mg., ὑψηλὰ, φρονεῖν).†
(AS)

G5310.def:
ὕψιστος, -η, -ον superlat., without positive in use, in cl. chiefly poët. (Æsch., Soph., al.),
[in LXX chiefly for עֶלְיוֹן, also for מָרוֹם, etc. ;]
highest, most high: of place, τὰ ὕ. (of the heavens), Mt 21:9, Mc 11:10, Lc 2:14 19:38 (cf. Joshua 16:19, Is 57:15); of God (in cl., of Zeus; Pind., Æsch., al.), ὕ., Lc 1:32, 35 1:76 6:35 (as frequently in Sir.4:10, al.); ὁ ὕ., At 7:48; ὁ θεὸς ὁ ὕ., Mc 5:7, Lc 8:28, At 16:17, Hb 7:1 (cf. Gn 14:18).†
(AS)

G5311.def:
ὕψος, -ους, τό
[in LXX for קוֹמָה, מָרוֹם, etc. ;]
height: Ef 3:18 Tg 1:9, Ap 21:16; of heaven (EV, on high), ἐξ ὕ., Lc 1:78 24:49; εἰς ὕ., Ef 4:8 (LXX)†
(AS)

G5312.def:
ὑψόω, -ῶ
(ὕψος), [in LXX chiefly for רוּם, also for גָּבַהּ, נָשָׂא, etc. ;]
to lift or raise up: with accusative, Jo 3:14 8:28 12:32, 34; ἕως τ. οὐρανοῦ, figuratively, pass., Mt 11:23, Lc 10:15. Metaphorical, to exalt, uplift: At 2:33 5:31, 2Co 11:7, Tg 4:10, 1Pe 5:6; opposite to ταπεινῶ, Lc 1:52; ἑαυτόν, Mt 23:12, Lc 4:11 18:14 (cf. ὑπερ-υψόω).†
(AS)

G5313.def:
ὕψωμα, -τος, τό
[in LXX: Jó 24:24 (†), Jdth.10:8 13:4 15:9 * ;]
__(a) height: Rm 8:39;
__(b) that which is lifted up, a barrier: 2Co 10:5.†
(AS)

G5314.def:
φάγος, -ου, ὁ
(φαγεῖν, see: ἐσθίω)
a glutton: Mt 11:19, Lc 7:34.†
(AS)

G5315.def:
φάγομαιHellenistic for cl. ἔδομαι, see: ἐσθίω.
ἐσθίω, and (poet, and late prose) ἔσθω,
[in LXX chiefly for אכל ;]
to eat;
__(a) absol.: Mt 14:20, 21 Mc 6:31, Jo 4:31, al.; ἐν τ. φαγεῖν (on this aor. form, see M, Pr., 111), 1Co 11:21; διδόναι φαγεῖν, with dative of person(s), Mc 5:43, al.; ἐ. καὶ πίνειν, Mt 6:25, 31 Lc 10:7, al.; of ordinary use of food and drink, 1Co 9:4 11:22; of partaking of food at table, Mc 2:16, Lc 5:30, al.; opposite to fasting, Mt 11:18, Lc 5:33, al.; of revelling, Mt 24:49, Lc 12:45 .
__(b) with accusative of thing(s): Mt 6:25, Mc 1:6, Jo 6:31, Rm 14:2, al.; ἄρτον (Heb. אָכַל לֶחֶם), Mt 15:2, Mc 3:20, al.; τὸν ἑαυτοῦ ἄ., 2Ts 3:12; ἄ. before παρά, genitive of person(s), 2Ts 3:8; τά before id., Lc 10:7; τ. πάσχα, Mt 26:17, Mc 14:12 al; τ. κυριακὸν δεῖπνον, 1Co 11:20; τ. θυσίας, 1Co 10:18; before ἐκ (= cl. part. genitive), Jo 6:26, 5o, 51, 1Co 11:28; ἀπό (cf. Heb. אָכַל מִן), Mt 15:27, Mc 7:28; metaphorically, to devour, consume: Hb 10:27, Tg 5:3, Ap 17:16 (cf. κατ-, συν-εσθίω) .
(AS)

G5316.def:
φαίνω
[in LXX for אוֹר hi., רָאָה ni., etc. ;]
__I. Act.,
__1. to bring to light, cause to appear (so most frequently in cl.).
__2. Absol., to give light, shine (Hom., Plat., al.): Jo 1:5 5:35, 2Pe 1:19, 1Jo 2:8, Ap 1:16 8:12 18:23 21:23.
__II. Pass., to come to light, appear, be manifest: Mt 2:7 13:26 24:27, 30, Lc 9:8, Fp 2:15, Hb 11:3, 1Pe 4:18" (LXX) ; opposite to ἀφανίζεσθαι, Jo 4:14; with dative of person(s) (Bl. § 54, 4), Mt 1:20 2:13, 19 Mc 16:9; with nom. pred., Mt 23:27-28, Rm 7:13, 2Co 13:7; id. with dative of person(s), Mt 6:5, 16 6:18 (before nom. ptcp., but not as in cl.; see Bl., § 73, 4); impers., Mt 9:33; of the mind and judgment (= δοκεῖ, which see), Mc 14:64 (cf. I Et 2:21), Lc 24:11.†
SYN.: see: δοκέω (AS)

G5317.def:
Φάλεκ (T, Rec. Φαλέκ, L, mg., Φάλεγ), ὁ indecl. (Heb. D, Ge 1116),
Peleg: Lc 3:35.†
(AS)

G5318.def:
φανερός, -ά, -όν
(φαίνομαι) [in LXX: Dt 29:29 (28) (גָּלָה ni.), Pv 14:4, Sir.6:22, al. ;]
open to sight, visible, manifest: Gl 5:19; before ἐν, Rm 1:19, 1Jo 3:10; with dative of person(s), At 4:16 7:13, 1Tm 4:15; φ. γίνεσθαι (in LXX for בָּחַן ni., Gn 42:16), Mc 6:14, Lc 8:17, 1Co 3:13 14:25; id. before ἐν, 1Co 11:19, Fp 1:13; φ. ποιεῖν, Mt 12:16, Mc 3:12; εἰς φ. ἐλθεῖν (cf. Bl., § 47, 2), Mc 4:22, Lc 8:17; ἐν τῷ φ. (opposite to ἐν τ. κρυπτῷ), Rm 2:28.†
SYN.: see: δῆλος (AS)

G5319.def:
φανερόω, -ώ
[in LXX: Jr 40:6 (33:6) (גָּלָה pi.) * ;]
to make visible, clear, manifest or known: with accusative of thing(s), Jo 2:11 17:6, Rm 1:19, 1Co 4:5, 2Co 2:14 11:6, Cl 4:4, Tt 1:3; pass., Mc 4:22, Jo 3:21 9:3, Rm 3:21 16:26, 2Co 4:10-11, Ef 5:13, Cl 1:26, 2Tm 1:10, Hb 9:8, 1Jo 3:2 Jn 4:9, Ap 3:18 15:4; with accusative of person(s), of Christ, Jo 7:4 21:1; pass., 2Co 3:3 5:10-11, 1Jo 2:19; of Christ, Mc 16:12, 14, Jo 1:31 21:14, Cl 3:4, 1Tm 3:16, Hb 9:26, 1Pe 1:20 5:4, 1Jo 1:2 (ἡ ζωή; see Westc., in l) 1Jo 2:28 Jn 3:2 Jn 3:5 Jn 3:8.†
SYN.: see: ἀποκαλύπτω (AS)

G5320.def:
φανερῶς
adv. (φανερός), [in LXX: 2Ma.3:28 * ;]
__(a) manifestly, openly: Mc 1:45; opposite to ἐν κρυπτῷ„ Jo 7:10;
__(b) clearly: At 10:3 (2Ma.3:28).†
(AS)

G5321.def:
φανέρωσις, -εως, ἡ
(φανερόω), [in LXX as seel. for δήλωσις אוּרִים), Lv 8:8, Cod. Ven. (Thayer, see word) * ;]
manifestation: 1Co 12:7, 2Co 4:2.†
(AS)

G5322.def:
φανός, -οῦ, ὁ
(φαίνω),
a torch or lantern (see Rutherford, NPhr., 131 f.): Jo 18:3.†
SYN.: see: λαμπάς (AS)

G5324.def:
φαντάζω
(φαίνω) [in LXX: Wis.6:16, Sir.31:5 (34:5)* ;]
to make visible. In cl. used in pass. only, = φαίνομαι, to become visible, appear: ptcp., Hb 12:21.†
(AS)

G5325.def:
φαντασία, -ας, ἡ
(φαντάζω), [in LXX: Zc 10:1 (חֲזִיז), חֲזִיז), Hc 2:18-19 3:10, Wis.18:17 * ;]
__1. as philos. term,
__(a) imagination;
__(b) = φάντασμα (Plat., Arist.).
__2. In later writers (Polyb., al.), show, display: At 25:23.†
(AS)

G5326.def:
φάντασμα, -τος, τό
(φαντάζω), [in LXX: Jó 20:8 A (חִזָּיוֹן), Is 28:7 A, Wis.17:15 * ;]
= φάσμα, an appearance, apparition (Æsch., al.): Mt 14:26, Mc 6:49 (see DCG, i, 111b).†
(AS)

G5327.def:
φάραγξ, -αγγος, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for נַחַל, also for גַּיְא, etc. ;]
a chasm, ravine: Lc 3:5 (LXX) (see DB, iv, 845 f.).†
(AS)

G5328G.def:
Φαραώ, ὁ indecl.
(in FlJ, Ant., viii, 6, 2, Φαραών, -ῶνος), (Heb. פַּרְעֹה),
Pharaoh, the general title of the kings of Egypt: At 7:13, 21, Rm 9:17, Hb 11:24; Φ. βασιλεὺς Αἰγύπτου, At 7:10.†
(AS)

G5328H.def:
Φαραώ, ὁ indecl.
(in FlJ, Ant., viii, 6, 2, Φαραών, -ῶνος), (Heb. פַּרְעֹה),
Pharaoh, the general title of the kings of Egypt: At 7:13, 21, Rm 9:17, Hb 11:24; Φ. βασιλεὺς Αἰγύπτου, At 7:10.†
(AS)

G5328I.def:
Φαραώ, ὁ indecl.
(in FlJ, Ant., viii, 6, 2, Φαραών, -ῶνος), (Heb. פַּרְעֹה),
Pharaoh, the general title of the kings of Egypt: At 7:13, 21, Rm 9:17, Hb 11:24; Φ. βασιλεὺς Αἰγύπτου, At 7:10.†
(AS)

G5329.def:
Φαρές, ὁ indecl. (Heb. פֶּרֶץ, Gn 38:29),
Peres: Mt 1:3, Lc 3:33.†
(AS)

G5330.def:
Φαρισαῖος, -ου, ὁ (Aram. פְּרִישָׁא; see Dalman, Gr., 157.n, Words, 2.n),
a Pharisee: Mt 23:26, Fp 3:5; usually in pl., Mt 9:11, Mc 2:18, al.; Φ. κ. γραμματεῖς, Mt 5:20, Mc 2:16, Lc 5:21, al.; Φ. κ. Σαδδυκαῖοι, Mt 16:1, At 23:6, 7 al.; ἀρχιερεῖς, Mt 21:45, Jo 7:32, al. (see DB, iii, 826b).
(AS)

G5331.def:
φαρμακία (Rec. -εία), -ας, ἡ
(φαρμακεύω, to administer drugs)
poët. and late prose form of φαρμακεία,
[in LXX: Êx 7:11, 22 8:7, 18 (3, 14) (לָט, חַרְטֹם), Is 47:9, 12 (כֶּשֶׁף) Wis.12:4 18:13 * ;]
__1. generally, the use of medicine, drugs or spells (Xen.).
__2. (a) poisoning (Plut., Polyb.);
__(b) sorcery, witchcraft: Gl 5:20 (see Lft., in l), Ap 9:21 (WH, txt., φαρμάκων) Ap 18:23 (cf. LXX, ll. with).†
(AS)

G5333.def:
φαρμακός, -ή, -όν
[in LXX for כָּשַׁף, etc. ;]
devoted to magical arts. As subst., ὁ φ. = φαρμακεύς, a magician, sorcerer: Ap 21:8 22:15.†
(AS)

G5334.def:
φάσις, -εως, ἡ
(φαίνω), [in LXX: Et 4:17, Da TH Su 1:55, 4Ma.15:25 א1 * ;]
information, esp. against fraud or other crime: At 21:31.†
(AS)

G5335.def:
φάσκω
[in LXX: Gn 26:20 (אָמַר), Dan LXX Bel 1:8, 2Ma.14:27 2Mac 14:32, 3Ma.3:7 * ;]
to affirm, assert: with accusative and inf., At 24:9 25:19; with inf. and nom., Rm 1:22.†
(AS)

G5336.def:
φάτνη, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX for אֵבוּס, etc. ;]
a manger: Lc 2:7, 12 2:16 13:15 (see DB, iii, 234a, DCG, ii, 111a),†
(AS)

G5337.def:
φαῦλος, -η, -ον
[in LXX: Pv 22:8 (עֶוֶל) Pv 29:9 (אֱוִיל), etc. ;]
slight, worthless, of no account, both of persons and things in various shades of meaning (see LS, see word), in NT, as frequently in cl., always with distinct moral reference (see Ellic., Past. Epp., 203; Hort, Ja., 85; Tr., Syn., LXXxiv), worthless, bad: Jo 3:20, Tt 2:8, Tg 3:16; opposite to ἀγαθός (which see), Jo 5:29, Rm 9:11, 2Co 5:10.†
SYN.: see: ἄθεσμος (AS)

G5338.def:
φέγγος, -ους, τό
[in LXX chiefly for נֹגַהּ ;]
light, brightness, usually with genitive of something that shines or reflects: of the moon, Mt 24:29, Mc 13:24; of a lamp, Lc 11:33 (WH, RV, φῶς).†
SYN.: αὐγή, q.v (AS)

G5339.def:
φείδομαι
[in LXX for חָמַל, חוּס, חָשַׂךְ, etc. ;]
to spare: 2Co 13:2; with genitive of person(s), At 20:29, Rm 8:32 11:21, 1Co 7:28, 2Co 1:23, 2Pe 2:4-5; with inf., to forbear, 2Co 12:6.†
(AS)

G5341.def:
φελόνης (Rec. φαιλ-), -ου, ὁ
by metath. for παινόλης (also φενόλης, φαινόλιον; Lat. pænula)
a cloak (see DCG, i, 338; on the idea that the meaning here is book-cover, see CGT, in l; Milligan, NTD, 20; Field, Notes, 217 f., where the view that the φ. here is an eccl. vestment is discussed): 2Tm 4:13.†
(AS)

G5342.def:
φέρω
[in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא. hi., also for נָשָׂא, etc. ;]
to bear;
__1. to bear, carry: with accusative, Lc 23:26 24:1, Jo 19:39, Hb 1:3 (see Westc., in l); pass., At 2:2 27:15, 17 Hb 6:1, 2Pe 1:17-18; of the mind, 2Pe 1:21.
__2. to bear, endure: with accusative of thing(s), Hb 12:20 13:13; with accusative of person(s), Rm 9:22.
__3. to bring, bring forward: with accusative of person(s), At 5:16; id. before πρός, Mc 1:32 2:3 9:17, 19-20; ἐπί, Lc 5:18; with dative, Mc 7:32 8:22; with accusative of thing(s), Mc 6:27 11:2 12:15, Lc 15:23, At 4:34, 37 5:2, 2Tm 4:13; id. before πρός, Mc 11:7; εἰς, Ap 21:24, 26; ἐπί, Mt 14:11, Mc 6:28; ἀπό, Jo 21:10; with dative, Mc 12:15, Jo 2:8; id. before ὧδε, Mt 14:18 17:17; before φαγεῖν (sc. τι), Jo 4:33; τ. δάκτυλον (χεῖρα), Jo 20:27; pass., ἡ χάρις, 1Pe 1:13; διδαχήν, II Jn 10; θάνατον (cf. Field, Notes, 230), Hb 9:16; κρίσιν, 2Pe 2:11; κατηγορίαν, Jo 18:29; αἰτίαν, At 25:18; αἰτιώματα, At 25:7, Rec.
__4. to bear, produce, bring forth: καρπόν, Mt 7:18, Mc 4:8, Jo 12:24 15:2, 4-5 15:8, 16.
__5. to bring, lead: Mc 15:22, Jo 21:18, At 14:13; metaphorically, of a gate (ὁδός, cl.), Seq. εἰς, At 12:10
(cf. ἀνα-, ἀπο-, δια-, εἰσ-, παρ-εισ-, ἐκ-, ἐπι-, κατα-, -παρα-, περι-, προ-, προσ-, συν-, ὑπο-φέρω).†
SYN: φορέω, which expresses habitual and continuous bearing as distinct from (φέρω) that which is accidental and temporary (cf. Mt 11:8, al., see word φορέω, and see Tr., Syn., § lviii)
(AS)

G5343.def:
φεύγω
[in LXX chiefly for נוּס, also for בָּרַח, etc. ;]
to flee from or away, take flight: absol., Mt 8:33 26:56, Mc 5:14 14:50, Lc 8:34, Jo 10:12, At 7:29; before εἰς, Mt 2:13 10:23 24:16 (WH, txt.), Mc 13:14, Lc 21:21, Ap 12:6; ἐπί, with accusative loc., Mt 24:16 (WH, mg.); ἐκ, At 27:30; ἀπό, with genitive loc. (cl.), Mc 16:8; id. with genitive of person(s) (as in Heb.), Jo 10:5, Tg 4:7. Metaphorical: absol., Ap 16:20; with accusative of thing(s), 1Co 6:18, Hb 11:34 (see M, Fr., 116); opposite to διώκειν, 1Tm 6:11, 2Tm 2:22; before άπό, with genitive of person(s), Ap 9:6; άπὸ τ. προσώπου, Ap 20:11; with genitive of thing(s), Mt 3:7 (M, Pr., l.with) Mt 23:33, Lc 3:7, 1Co 10:14 (cf. ἀπο-, δια-, ἐκ-, κατα-φεύγω).†
(AS)

G5344.def:
φῆλιξ (L, Φή-), -ικος, ὁ
Felix, procurator of Judæa: At 23:24, 26 24:3, 22 24:24-25, 27 25:14.†
(AS)

G5345.def:
φήμη, -ης, ἡ
(φημί) [in LXX: Pv 16:2 (15:30) (שְׁמוּעָה), 2Ma.4:39, 3Ma.3:2, 4Ma.4:22 * ;]
a saying or report: Mt 9:26, Lc 4:14.†
(AS)

G5346.def:
φημί
[in LXX chiefly for נָאַם, also for אָמַר; frequently in 2-4 Mac ;]
to declare, say: frequently in quoting the words of another, Mt 13:29 26:61, Lc 7:40 22:58, Jo 1:23, al.; interjected into the recorded words (cl.), Mt 14:8, At 23:35, al.; φησί, impersonal (Bl., § 30, 4), 1Co 6:16 (Lft., Notes, 217; but cf. Bl., l.with), 2Co 10:10 (WH, mg., φασίν), Hb 8:5; joined with syn. verb (cf. LS, see word, II, 2), ἀποκριθεὶς αὐτῷ ἔφη, Lc 23:3; before -πρός, Lc 22:70, al.; with accusative of thing(s), 1Co 10:15 10:19; accusative and inf., Rm 3:8; before ὅτι (Bl., § 70, 3), 1Co 10:19 15:50 (cf. σύν-φημι)
(AS)

G5347.def:
φῆστος, -ου, ὁ
(Porcius), Festus, procurator of Judæa: At 24:27 25:1 ff. At 26:24-25, 32.†
(AS)

G5348.def:
φθάνω
[in LXX for נָגַע hi., מְטָא, etc. ;]
__1. to come before another, anticipate (cl.): with accusative of person(s), 1Ts 4:15.
__2. In late writers and MGr. (see Kennedy, Sources, 156; Lft., Notes, 35), to come, arrive: Rm 9:31; before εἰς, Fp 3:16; ἄχρι, 2Co 10:14; ἐπί (cf. Da TH Dn 4:21, and see Dalman, Words, 107), Mt 12:28, Lc 11:20, 1Ts 2:16 (cf. προ-φθάνω).†
(AS)

G5349.def:
φθαρτός, -ή, -όν (φθείρω)
[in LXX: Lv 22:25 (מִשְׁחָת), Is 54:17 A א3, Wis.9:15 14:8, 2Ma.7:16 * ;]
perishable, corruptible: ἄνθρωπος, Rm 1:23 (opposite to ἄφθαρτος θεός); στέφανος, 1Co 9:25 (opposite to αρτος); σπσρά, 1Pe 1:23 (opposite to ἄφθ.); neut., τὸ φ. τοῦτο, 1Co 15:53-54; pl., 1Pe 1:18.†
(AS)

G5350.def:
φθέγγομαι
[in LXX for עָנָה, נָבַע hi., etc. ;]
of men or animals, to utter a sound or voice: absol., At 4:18; before ἐν φωνῇ, 2Pe 2:16; with accusative, ὑπέρογκα, 2Pe 2:18.†
(AS)

G5351.def:
φθείρω
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁחַת hi., pi., also for חָבַל, etc. ;]
to destroy, corrupt, spoil (on the varied usage and distinctive meaning of the word, see Mayor on 2Pe, App., 175 ff.): with accusative, 1Co 3:17 15:23, 2Co 7:2; before ἀπό, 2Co 11:3; ἐν, 2Pe 2:12, Ju 10, Ap 19:2; κατά, Ef 4:22 (cf. δια-, κατα-φθείρω).†
(AS)

G5352.def:
φθιν-οπωρινός, -ή, -όν
(φθινόπωρον, late autumn),
autumnal: δένδρα φ., autumn trees (said to be without fruit therefore at a time when fruit might be expected; see Mayor's elaborate note, Ep. Ju., 55-59, and reff. there): Ju 12.†
(AS)

G5353.def:
φθόγγος, -ου, ὁ
(φθέγγομαι), [in LXX: Sl 19:4 (קַו), Wis.19:18 * ;]
a sound: Rm 10:18 (LXX) 1Co 14:7.†
(AS)

G5354.def:
φθονέω, -ῶ
(φθόνος), [in LXX: Tob.4:7, 16 AB * ;]
to envy: with dative (L, txt., Tr., mg., WH, mg., accusative), as in cl., Gl 5:26.†
(AS)

G5355.def:
φθόνος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: Wis.2:24 6:23, 1Ma.8:16, 3Ma.6:7 * ;]
envy: Rm 1:29, Gl 5:21, 1Tm 6:4, Tt 3:3, 1Pe 2:1; διὰ φθόνον, Mt 27:18, Mc 15:10, Fp 1:15; πρὸς φθόνον ἐπιποθεῖ τ. πνεῦμα (on the meaning, see R, txt., mg. 1, 2; Hort, Ja., 93 f.), Tg 4:5.†
(AS)

G5356.def:
φθορά, -ᾶς, ἡ
(φθείρω) [in LXX for שַׁחַת, חֶבֶל, etc. ;]
destruction, corruption, decay (see Mayor on 2Pe, App.,175 ff.): Rm 8:21, 1Co 15:42, Cl 2:22, 2Pe 2:12; opposite to ζωὴ αἰώνιος, Gl 6:8; by meton., of that which is subject to corruption, 1Co 15:50; of moral decay, 2Pe 1:4 2:12 2:19 (cf. Wis.14:12).†
(AS)

G5357.def:
φιάλη, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for מִזְרָק ;]
a shallow bowl (= Lat. patera), used for pouring libations, etc.: Ap 5:8 15:7 16:1-17 17:1 21:9.†
(AS)

G5358.def:
φιλ-άγαθος, -ον
[in LXX: Wis.7:22 * ;]
loving that which is good, loving goodness: Tt 1:8 (Arist., Polyb., a l.).†
(AS)

G5359.def:
Φιλαδελφία (Rec. -έλφεια), -ας, ἡ
Philadelphia, a city of Lydia: Ap 1:11 3:7.†
(AS)

G5360.def:
φιλαδελφία, -ας, ἡ
(φιλάδελφος), [in LXX: 4Ma.13:23 4Mac 13:26 4Mac 14:1 * ;]
the love of brothers, brotherly love: of Christians' mutual love as brethren (see: ἀδελφός), Rm 12:10, 1Ts 4:9, Hb 13:1, 1Pe 1:22, 2Pe 1:7.†
(AS)

G5361.def:
φιλ-άδελφος, -ον
[in LXX: 2Ma.15:14, 4Ma.13:21 4Mac 15:10 * ;]
loving one's brother, loving like a brother (Soph., Xen., al.): of Christians' love for one another (EV, loving as brethren), 1Pe 3:8.†
(AS)

G5362.def:
φίλανδρος, -ον
__1. loving men (Æsch.).
__2. Of a wife, loving her husband (frequently in epitaphs, see LS, see word, Deiss., BS, 255): Tt 2:4.†
(AS)

G5363.def:
φιλανθρωπία, -ας, ἡ
(φιλάνθρωπος, humane), [in LXX: Et 8:13, 2Ma.6:22 2Mac 14:9, 3Ma.3:15 3Mac 3:18 * ;]
humanity, kindness (see Field, Notes, 147 f.): At 28:2, Tt 3:4 (cf. also DCG, ii, 356 ff.).†
(AS)

G5365.def:
φιλαργυρία, -ας, ἡ
(φιλάργυρος), [in LXX: 4Ma.1:26 4Mac 2:15 א1 * ;]
love of money, avarice: 1Tm 6:1.†
SYN.: πλεονεξία, covetousness (see Tr., Syn., § xxiv) (AS)

G5367.def:
φίλ-αυτος, -ον
loving oneself (Arist.); in bad sense (ib.), selfish: 2Tm 3:2.†
SYN.: αὐθάδης (see Tr., Syn., § xciii) (AS)

G5368.def:
φιλέω, -ῶ
(φίλος), [in LXX: Gn 27:4, 9, al. (אָהַב), Gn 27:27, al. (נָשַׁק), La 1:2 (רֵעַ) Wis.8:2, al. ;]
__1. to love (with the love of emotion and friendship, Lat, amare; v, SYN.): with accusative of person(s), Mt 10:37, Jo 5:20; Jo 11:3, 36 15:19 16:27 20:2 21:15-17, 1Co 16:22, Ap 3:19; ἐν πίστει, Tt 3:15; with accusative of thing(s), Mt 23:6, Lc 20:46, Jo 12:25, Ap 22:15; with inf. (Is 56:10; cf. Bl., § 69, 4), Mt 6:5.
__2. to kiss: with accusative of person(s), Mt 26:48, Mc 14:44, Lc 22:47 (cf. κατα-φιλέω).†
SYN.: ἀγαπάω ω (which see), the love of duty and respect (AS)

G5370.def:
φίλημα, -τος, τό
(φιλέω), [in LXX: Pv 27:6, Ct 1:2 (נְשִׁיקָה) * ;]
a kiss: Lc 7:45 22:48; as a token of Christian brotherhood, φ. ἅγιον, Rm 16:16, 1Co 16:20, 2Co 13:12, 1Ts 5:26; φ. ἀγάπης, 1Pe 5:14 (see Lft., Notes, 90; DB, DCA, see word "Kiss").†
(AS)

G5373.def:
φιλία, -ας, ἡ
(φίλος), [in LXX chiefly for אַהֲבָה ;]
friendship: with genitive obj., Tg 4:4.†
(AS)

G5374.def:
φιλιππήσιος, -ου, ὁ
(for other forms in use, see Lft., in l)
a Philippian: Fp 4:15.†
(AS)

G5375.def:
φίλιπποι, -ων, οἱ
(on the pl., see WM, § 27, 3)
Philippi: At 16:12 20:6, Fp 1:1, 1Ts 2:2.†
(AS)

G5376G.def:
φίλιππος, -ου, ὁ
Philip;
__1. the husband of Herodias: Mt 14:3, Mc 6:17.
__2. The tetrarch: Mt 16:13, Mc 8:27, Lc 3:1.
__3. The apostle: Mt 10:3, Mc 3:18, Lc 6:14, Jo 1:44-49 6:5, 7 12:21-22 14:8-9, At 1:13.
__4. The deacon and evangelist: At 6:5 8:5-40 21:8.†
(AS)

G5376H.def:
φίλιππος, -ου, ὁ
Philip;
__1. the husband of Herodias: Mt 14:3, Mc 6:17.
__2. The tetrarch: Mt 16:13, Mc 8:27, Lc 3:1.
__3. The apostle: Mt 10:3, Mc 3:18, Lc 6:14, Jo 1:44-49 6:5, 7 12:21-22 14:8-9, At 1:13.
__4. The deacon and evangelist: At 6:5 8:5-40 21:8.†
(AS)

G5376I.def:
φίλιππος, -ου, ὁ
Philip;
__1. the husband of Herodias: Mt 14:3, Mc 6:17.
__2. The tetrarch: Mt 16:13, Mc 8:27, Lc 3:1.
__3. The apostle: Mt 10:3, Mc 3:18, Lc 6:14, Jo 1:44-49 6:5, 7 12:21-22 14:8-9, At 1:13.
__4. The deacon and evangelist: At 6:5 8:5-40 21:8.†
(AS)

G5376J.def:
φίλιππος, -ου, ὁ
Philip;
__1. the husband of Herodias: Mt 14:3, Mc 6:17.
__2. The tetrarch: Mt 16:13, Mc 8:27, Lc 3:1.
__3. The apostle: Mt 10:3, Mc 3:18, Lc 6:14, Jo 1:44-49 6:5, 7 12:21-22 14:8-9, At 1:13.
__4. The deacon and evangelist: At 6:5 8:5-40 21:8.†
(AS)

G5376K.def:
φίλιππος, -ου, ὁ
Philip;
__1. the husband of Herodias: Mt 14:3, Mc 6:17.
__2. The tetrarch: Mt 16:13, Mc 8:27, Lc 3:1.
__3. The apostle: Mt 10:3, Mc 3:18, Lc 6:14, Jo 1:44-49 6:5, 7 12:21-22 14:8-9, At 1:13.
__4. The deacon and evangelist: At 6:5 8:5-40 21:8.†
(AS)

G5378.def:
1. fond of speaking , (Plato Philosophus)
2. fond of learning, literary , Lat. studiosus, (Aristotle Philosopher) (ML)

G5379.def:
φιλονεικία, -ας, ἡ
(φιλόνεικος), [in LXX: 2Ma.4:4, 4Ma.1:26 4Mac 8:26 * ;]
love of strife, rivalry, emulation (Plat., al.), but mostly in bad sense (Thuc., al.), contentiousness, contention: Lc 22:24 (but see Field, Notes, 75 f.).†
(AS)

G5380.def:
φιλό-νεικος, -ον
(νεῖκος, strife) [in LXX: Eze.3:7 (חָזָק ־מֵצַח)* ;]
fond of strife, contentious: 1Co 11:16.†
(AS)

G5381.def:
φιλο-ξενία, -ας, ἡ
(φιλόξενος),
love of strangers, hospitality: Rm 12:13, Hb 13:2.†
(AS)

G5383.def:
φιλο-πρωτιύω
(φιλόπρωτος, Plut., al.)
to strive to be first: III Jn 9 (eccl.).†
(AS)

G5384.def:
φίλος, -η, -ον
[in LXX chiefly for רֵעַ, אָהַב ;]
__1. pass., beloved, dear (Hom., Eur., al.).
__2. Act., loving, friendly (in cl. less frequently and only in poets): At 19:31. As subst., a friend;
__(a) masc., ὁ φ.: Lc 7:6 11:5 14:10 15:6 16:9 21:16 23:12, At 27:3, 3Jn.14; opposite to δοῦλος, Jo 15:15; φ. ἀναγκαῖοι, At 10:24; with genitive subj., Mt 11:19, Lc 7:34 11:6, 8 12:4 14:12 15:29, Jo 11:11 15:13-14; ὁ φ. τοῦ νυμφίου, Jo 3:29; τ. Καίσαρος (see Deiss., BS 167; LAE, 382 f.), Jo 19:12; θεοῦ (see Hort, in l), Tg 2:23; with genitive of thing(s), τ, κόσμου, Tg 4:4;
__(b) fem., ἡ φ., Lc 15:9,†
(AS)

G5385.def:
Φιλο-σοφία, -ας, ἡ
(φιλόσοφος), [in LXX: 4Ma.1:1 4Mac 5:10 4Mac 5:22 4Mac 7:9 4Mac 7:21 * ;]
the love and pursuit of wisdom; hence, philosophy, investi­gation of truth and nature: of the so-called philosophy of false teachers, Cl 2:8 (see Lft., ICC, in l).†
(AS)

G5386.def:
φιλό-σοφος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: Dan LXX 1:20 (אַשָּׁף), 4Ma.1:1 4Mac 5:35 4Mac 7:7 * ;]
a philosopher: At 17:18.†
(AS)

G5387.def:
φιλόστοργος, -ον
(στοργή, family affection), [in LXX: 4Ma.15:13 * ;]
tenderly loving, affectionate (Xen., Plut., al.): of Christians, Rm 12:10.†
(AS)

G5388.def:
φιλότεκνος, -ον
(φίλος, τέκνον), [in LXX: 4Ma.15:4-6 * ;]
loving one's children (Hdt., Arist., Plut., al.): of women, joined with φίλανδρος, which see, Tt 2:4.†
(AS)

G5389.def:
φιλοτιμέομαι, -οῦμαι
(φίλος, τιμή), [in LXX: 4Ma.1:35 A ;]
to love or seek after honour, hence, to be ambitious, emulous (Plat., Plut., al.): with inf., Rm 15:20, 2Co 5:9, 1Ts 4:11.†
(AS)

G5392.def:
φιμόω, -ῶ
(φιμός, a muzzle), [in LXX: Dt 25:4 (חָסַם), Dan LXX Su 1:61, 4Ma.1:35 א R * ;]
to muzzle: 1Co 9:9, 1Tm 5:18" (LXX) ; metaphorically, to put to silence: with accusative of person(s), Mt 22:34, 1Pe 2:15; pass., to be silenced, silent: Mt 22:12, Mc 1:25 4:39, Lc 4:35.†
(AS)

G5394.def:
φλογίζω
(φλόξ), [in LXX: Êx 9:24 (לָקַח hith.), Nm 21:14 (†), Sl 97:3 (לָהַט pi.), Da TH Dn 3:27(94) (חָרַךְ ithp.), Sir.3:30, 1Ma.3:5 * ;]
to set on fire, burn, burn up: figuratively, Tg 3:6 (on the meaning of the sentence, see Hort, in l).†
(AS)

G5395.def:
φλόξ genitive, φλογός,
[in LXX chiefly for לַהַב, לֶהָבָה ;]
a flame: Lc 16:24; φ, πυρός, At 7:30, 2Ts 1:8, Hb 1:7" (LXX), Ap 1:14 2:18 19:12.†
(AS)

G5396.def:
φλυαρέω, -ῶ
(φλύαρος),
to talk nonsense: with accusative of person(s), ἡμᾶς (EV, prating against us), III Jn 10.†
(AS)

G5397.def:
φλύαρος, -ον
(φλύω, to babble), [in LXX: 4Ma.5:10 * ;]
babbling, garrulous: 1Tm 5:13 (EV, tattlers; of things, φιλοσοφία, 4Mac, l.with).†
(AS)

G5398.def:
φοβερός, -ά, -όν
(φοβέω), [in LXX chiefly for יָרֵא, also for דְּחַל, אָיֹם ;]
fearful, whether act, or pass.;
__1. act., = δεινός, causing fear, terrible (LXX): Hb 10:27, 31 12:21
__2. Pass., = δειλός, feeling fear, timid (cl. in both senses).†
(AS)

G5399.def:
φοβέέω, ῶ
(φόβος) [in LXX chiefly for מִן יָרֵא ;]
__1. in Hem., to put to flight. Pass., to be put to flight, to flee affrighted
__2. to terrify, frighten (Wis 179; Hdt. and Att..). Pass. (so always in NT; cf. M, Pr., 162), to be seized with fear, be affrighted, fear: Mt 10:31 14:27, Mc 5:33 6:50, Lc 1:13 8:50, Jo 6:19 12:15, At 16:38, al.; opposite to ὑψηλοφρονεῖν, Rm 11:20; σφόδρα, Mt 17:6 27:54; with cogn. accusative, φόβον μέγαν, Mc 4:41, Lc 2:9 (1Ma.10:8); φόβον αὐτῶν (obj, genitive, but cf. ICC, in l), 1Pe 3:14; πτόησιν, 1Pe 3:6; with accusative of person(s), Mt 10:26, Mc 11:18, Lc 19:21, Jo 9:22, At 9:26,
Rm 13:3, al.; before ἀπό (like Heb. יָרֵא, Jr 1:8, al.; cf. M, Pr., 102, 104n„), Mt 10:28, Lc 12:4; before μή (cl.; Bl., § 65, 3; M, Pr., 184 f.), At 23:10 27:17; μήπως, At 27:29, 2Co 11:3 12:20, Gl 4:11; μήποτε, Hb 4:1; with inf. (Bl., § 69, 4; M, Pr., 205), Mt 1:20, Mc 9:32, al.; of reverential fear: Mc 6:20, Ef 5:33; τ. θεόν, Lc 1:50, At 10:2, 1Pe 2:17, Ap 14:7, al.; τ. κύριον, Cl 3:22, Ap 15:4; τ. ὄνομα τ. θεοῦ (see: ὄνομα), Ap 11:18; οἱ φοβούμενοι τ. θεόν, of proselytes, At 13:16, 26 (cf. ἐκ-φοβέω)
(AS)
